title: Computer Freeze while Screen Sharing or Go Live FAQ
body:
If you have AMD Ryzen CPU and NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3xxxx graphics card, you may experience system freeze, mouse lags and/or audio popping.

Troubleshooting Steps:

  1. Try setting the video card slot to PCI-e 3.0. This resolved the issue for most users.
  2. Please ensure that you have the latest BIOS.
  3. Disable GeForce Experience.

How to Check your System:

  1. Run the dxdiag command.
  2. Check your processor under System tab and graphics card under Display tab.
